content: Human-labeling session — action-sequenced-execution:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a long-range ordered patrol on a large 80x48 map. You are given two columns of 6 units each (2 medium tanks + 2 light tanks + 2 jeeps), one deployed far north and one far south, all on hold-fire orders. Each column must run a four-stop ordered route, with stops labelled by relative direction (north, centre, east, far corner). Coordinates are NOT given — each waypoint is an enemy building hidden in fog. When a unit sights one, an interrupt will reveal its exact location. Both ordered routes must be completed within 5000 ticks, holding losses to one or fewer.
